decisive_reason: The evaluator accepts adapter-self-asserted PRODUCT_LIVE evidence. Relabeling and rehashing TEMP-only reference artifacts produced product PASS for all ten journeys without any external target, effect, provider, or independent observation.

R1-C02.primary_evidence: The runner accepts an arbitrary subprocess command without a shell. AST inspection of all 12 R1 Python files found zero jarvis_foundry imports and zero dynamic import/eval sites.

R1-C04.primary_evidence: The exact bf8f1493 prototype probe returned exit 1 and 10/10 journey FAIL with nonempty missing-endpoint evidence. Installed entrypoint invocation was false, database files created was zero, and repository status was unchanged.

A stronger semantically equivalent mutant using self-asserted REAL_EXTERNAL_EFFECT labels passed all journeys, so the matrix does not discriminate real proof from relabeled fixture proof.

The evaluator does not independently execute or inspect these semantic requirements.

The independent 985-test reproduction was intentionally not run after the decisive semantic FAIL. Builder JUnit evidence reports 985/0 but is not independent reproduction.

The adversarial reproduction disproved the overall R1 gate.

fresh_findings.finding: Untrusted adapters can self-assert PRODUCT_LIVE, REAL_EXTERNAL_EFFECT, source identity, target state, actor independence, and outcome booleans. Rehashing TEMP-only reference evidence then yields all-ten product PASS.
BLOCKED, NOT_TESTED, and WAITING are unvalidated adapter assertions with no mandatory reason, dependency, wait event, resume condition, or status-specific evidence.

exact_repair_conditions: Preserve this verifier FAIL before changing the implementation and register R1-F006 and R1-F007 durably.
Make requested proof scope evaluator-owned and frozen in the request. An adapter must not promote itself from HARNESS_SELF_TEST to PRODUCT_LIVE.

Require PRODUCT_LIVE evidence to be verified by an evaluator-controlled registered observer or SystemAdapter.inspect path bound to canonical target identity, account/service identity, challenge nonce, before state, after state, idempotency key, and external receipt.
Do not allow a file beneath run_root to qualify as the external target. It may be an evidence copy only; the evaluator must independently inspect the actual target.
Replace string inequality of actor_run_id and verifier_run_id with independently issued identities or attestations bound to separate execution contexts and frozen artifacts.

Make semantic journey requirements executable: actual restart, duplicate delivery, failure injection, recovery, rollback, compensation, usefulness, and after-state checks cannot be satisfied by booleans or merely listing injection IDs.

Add a regression that starts from the canonical reference response, changes proof scope to PRODUCT_LIVE, changes every payload to REAL_EXTERNAL_EFFECT, assigns distinct self-asserted actor/verifier IDs, rehashes and relinks every record, and requires deterministic FAIL with a dedicated untrusted-live-proof code.

Add rehashed source-locator, target-receipt, actor-identity, and verifier-identity spoof mutants. They must fail for the intended semantic reason while the canonical reference remains HARNESS_SELF_TEST_ONLY.

Extend the protocol with status-specific reason codes and evidence. BLOCKED requires an identified unavailable external dependency; WAITING requires a durable wait event/resume condition; NOT_TESTED requires named unexecuted criteria; implementation/protocol failure remains FAIL.
Add regressions proving that blind status flips to BLOCKED, NOT_TESTED, or WAITING are rejected.

After repair, rerun the focused suite, the isolated external-TEMP 985-test suite, all strengthened mutants, resource checks, exact manifest closure, protected-state guards, and a fresh independent verifier round.
